rubrics.justification: It correctly states that no image was provided and avoids fabricating morphology, but therefore offers no actual blastocyst feature assessment.
It integrates age, oocyte maturity, diagnosis, endometrium, sperm parameters, lifestyle, and first-cycle status well, though some links to embryo quality are assumed rather than demonstrated.
The reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately conditioned on missing morphology, though probability estimates rely on assumed good-quality blastocyst status.

SET recommendation and general prognosis are guideline-consistent, but suggesting routine hysteroscopy/SIS before transfer and considering PGT-A after one failed transfer in a 28-year-old is somewhat overreaching.
Provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, but some recommendations are generic and a few are not tightly tailored to this low-risk first-cycle case.
